title: Jerome on Ezra 1:1
body: “Ezra and Nehemiah, that is the Lord's helper and His consoler, are united in a single book.”
author: Jerome, Letter 53, to Paulinus
bodyEs: “Esdras y Nehemías, esto es, el ayudador del Señor y su consolador, están unidos en un solo libro.”

title: John Chrysostom on Ezra 6:15
body: “Forty and six years," they said, referring to the latter building, for the former was finished in twenty years' time.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews
bodyEs: “En cuarenta y seis años", dijeron, refiriéndose al edificio posterior, porque el anterior se terminó en veinte años.”
